'''Crazy Van Kyle''' was a member of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Hurt Vectors]]. The criminal carried two [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shivs]] in concealed wrist-sheaths, and was involved in a battle with a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] at the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang's [[Hurt Vectors hideout|hideout]].
